en.role: Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Industry and Trade
en.quote: Commercial deliveries of the fully Russianized aircraft [the MC-21] will also begin in 2025.
en.head: Commercial deliveries did not begin in 2025.
en.body: In June 2025, Rostec said the domestically equipped MS-21 was undergoing certification trials and that deliveries to customers were expected in 2026. Its chief repeated that timetable in August. The promised commercial deliveries did not begin in 2025.

osrc.t: Rostec, MS-21 certification and delivery schedule
